supersedes_protocol.reason: Before any panel decision or outcome was collected, mechanical QC found an impossible self-reference: v2 required decision_evidence_blob inside the immutable decision record itself and outcome_evidence_blob inside its own record. v2.1 replaces those fields with two-phase external readback seals. No data-dependent retuning occurred.

prospective_panel.admission_rule: Only a round with a decision record durably read back and externally sealed before factual-candidate semantic read/execution may enter. Outcome/archive update requires terminal evidence readback, then an immutable outcome record, then external outcome-record readback seal.
prospective_panel.candidate_set_rule: Complete set of current self_improvement OPEN frontier items, excluding the calibration tracker, that were declared_before_semantic_read=true and already contain stable candidate_id, strategy_class, integer priority_index, declared_at_sequence and safe_chat_capable=true; no protected-authority requirement may be present. Exact candidates copied into decision record.

sticky_policy.choice_rule: Prefer eligible candidates in sticky_incumbent_strategy_class; within class choose smallest priority_index then candidate_id. If none, choose global smallest priority_index then candidate_id.
sticky_policy.update_rule: After valid externally sealed outcome record, sticky incumbent class becomes factual candidate strategy_class. No update on invalid/duplicate/unsealed records.

history_policy.archive_scope: Valid factual outcomes from this v2.1 panel only.
history_policy.class_value: Arithmetic mean terminal_utility by strategy_class; unobserved class prior exactly 1.0.
history_policy.choice_rule: Highest class_value; tie higher observation count; then smaller priority_index; then candidate_id.
history_policy.archive_update_timing: Only after outcome record readback seal; never same round before choice.

factual_policy_schedule.rule: Rounds alternate HISTORY, STICKY, HISTORY, STICKY ... starting HISTORY at round 1.
factual_policy_schedule.agreement_rule: If both choose same candidate, factual candidate is that candidate and realized utility is observable for both action-identical policies.
factual_policy_schedule.disagreement_rule: Execute scheduled policy candidate only; other policy utility remains MISSING; no imputation.

validity_requirements: decision record sealed before semantic read

decision_record.seal_rule: After immutable decision record is created, fetch it and store its repository blob SHA in later controller state as decision_record_blob with decision_sealed=true. Semantic read/execution of factual candidate is forbidden until that external seal exists and is read back.

outcome_record.seal_rule: After immutable outcome record is created, fetch it and store its repository blob SHA in later controller state as outcome_record_blob with outcome_sealed=true. Archive/incumbent update is forbidden until that external seal exists and is read back.

reporting.disagreement_winner_rule: Require >=2 valid disagreement exposures assigned to each policy. Then DESCRIPTIVE winner only by mean realized terminal_utility on those factual disagreement rounds; tie => TIE.
reporting.counterfactual_rule: No paired regret/unexecuted utility without separately preregistered dual-outcome acquisition.

interpretation_guard: v2.1 is a pre-data protocol correction, not performance tuning. It preserves v2 policy semantics while making durability binding physically realizable through external readback seals.
